movement_profile.footwork: circular movement in a counter-clockwise direction around the drummers, starting slow and syncopated and progressively accelerating

signature_moves.description: Counter-clockwise circular movement around drummers that accelerates until dancers enter a mayal trance state.
signature_moves.name: Mayal Trance Dance

movement_profile.tempo_feel: starts slow and syncopated, accelerating progressively into trance

teaching.level_notes: Advanced practice embedded in spiritual initiation or family lineage (Bongo)
